questions.prompt: Does the system integrate with the bank's existing SSO/OIDC identity provider (roles supplied as external claims), or should it own local user accounts and role assignment?
questions.why: Determines whether to build local user/role management or implement OIDC/SSO integration. Changes authentication architecture, database schema, and API design.

questions.prompt: For credit committee approval on deals above $1,000,000, is approval a single action by any committee member, or a multi-member vote requiring a defined quorum/threshold recorded per voter?
questions.why: Affects approval workflow UI, database audit trail schema, and approval logic. Single-member vs multi-vote changes how approval state and blocking conditions are modeled.

questions.prompt: For approval tiering, is 'exposure amount' the requested amount of the single deal, or aggregate outstanding plus proposed exposure across the borrower and its related entities?
questions.why: Changes whether exposure calculation requires borrower entity relationship queries and aggregation logic. Impacts the approval tier determination logic and potentially the data model for entity relationships.

questions.prompt: Must the document extraction stage parse real uploaded PDFs, scans, and spreadsheets, or does it operate on structured/typed financial input with documents attached for reference only?
questions.why: Determines whether the financial spreading agent uses OCR/document parsing or structured data entry. Real document parsing requires external AI vision models and OCR pipelines; structured input uses direct form entry with document storage for audit.
